selection: Minimum development mean candidate regret after four decision-aware questions, pooled with equal family weight. Ties favor decay 1.0. No held-out selection.
primary: Paired candidate-regret reduction: fixed-four selected decay versus fixed-four decay 1.0. Stratified persona bootstrap, 95% interval. Null results retained.
secondary: Ask/recommend/defer trade-offs: candidate regret over all personas, conditional recommended regret, coverage, bad-recommendation rate, deferral recall and unnecessary deferrals, questions, illustrative loss, latency and traced allocations.
pairing: Shared personas, constraints, response draws by step, and disjoint held-out comparison pairs per persona. Draws pair steps, not identical pairs. Resample personas within families, never questions as independent people.
limits: All fictional synthetic tasks. Known families, independent held-out personas; no unseen-family or human generalization claim. Drift occurs after two answers regardless of whether a policy asks. Models cannot observe unasked future changes. Feature corruption affects preference inputs, never authoritative prices/fit. No hypothesis of universal improvement. No sponsor or provider calls.
